item.title: Transforming Waste Into Wealth: Cucurbit[6]uril‐Functionalized MXene for Iodine Removal and High‐Performance Supercapacitor Applications
item.description:
کامپوزیت CB[6]-MXene با ظرفیت جذب بالای ید (741 mg g−1) و سپس I2@CB[6]-MXene به‌عنوان ابرخازن با ظرفیت 2246 F g−1 و پایداری چرخه‌ای 86% عمل می‌کند.
Small | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a dual-function CB[6]-MXene composite that first captures iodine (741 mg g⁻¹, highest for MXene adsorbents) and then reuses the iodine-loaded material as a supercapacitor electrode, boosting performance by 246% (2246 F g⁻¹). Its significance is a sustainable "waste-to-wealth" strategy combining water remediation with advanced energy storage, supported by DFT mechanistic insight.
🏷 MXene · cucurbit[6]uril · iodine adsorption · supercapacitor · waste-to-wealth

item.title: Multiscale Pore Networks Enable Tortuosity Modulation in MXene for Ultrafast Energy Storage
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using differential-gas adsorption to engineer a trimodal hierarchical pore network in Ti3CNTx MXene, balancing low-tortuosity meso/macroporous transport highways with microporous storage sites. This resolves the kinetic bottleneck limiting 2D electrodes, achieving 434 F g−1 and exceptional rate capability (307 F g−1 at 1000 mV s−1), establishing a universal paradigm for tortuosity modulation in ultrafast energy storage.
